# order-service

Small order service used by the team. TypeScript on Node 24, SQLite via the built-in `node:sqlite`.

```
src/
  app.ts            wiring: createApp({ db?, clock? }) -> { db, request(method, path, body) }
  router.ts         tiny JSON router, maps AppError -> { error: { code, message } }
  routes/           HTTP layer only: parse params, call a service
  services/         business rules
  repositories/     all SQL lives here
  db.ts             schema (orders, coupons, coupon_redemptions)
tests/              vitest
```

Commands: `npm run build` (type check), `npm test`.

Conventions:

- money is integer cents;
- time comes from the injected `Clock`, never `new Date()` inside services;
- errors are thrown as `AppError` with an UPPER_SNAKE code.

1: import { AppError } from "./errors.ts";
2: 
3: export interface HttpResponse {
4:   status: number;
5:   body: unknown;
6: }
7: 
8: export type Handler = (params: Record<string, string>, body: any) => HttpResponse;
9: 
10: interface Route {
11:   method: string;
12:   pattern: RegExp;
13:   keys: string[];
14:   handler: Handler;
15: }
16: 
17: /** Minimal path router: "/orders/:id" style patterns, JSON in, JSON out. */
18: export class Router {
19:   private readonly routes: Route[] = [];
20: 
21:   add(method: string, path: string, handler: Handler): void {
22:     const keys: string[] = [];
23:     const source = path.replace(/:(\w+)/g, (_, k: string) => {
24:       keys.push(k);
25:       return "([^/]+)";
26:     });
27:     this.routes.push({ method, pattern: new RegExp(`^${source}$`), keys, handler });
28:   }
29: 
30:   handle(method: string, path: string, body: unknown): HttpResponse {
31:     for (const r of this.routes) {
32:       if (r.method !== method) continue;
33:       const m = r.pattern.exec(path);
34:       if (!m) continue;
35:       const params = Object.fromEntries(r.keys.map((k, i) => [k, decodeURIComponent(m[i + 1])]));
36:       try {
37:         return r.handler(params, body ?? {});
38:       } catch (e) {
39:         if (e instanceof AppError) return { status: e.status, body: { error: { code: e.code, message: e.message } } };
40:         return { status: 500, body: { error: { code: "INTERNAL_ERROR", message: String(e) } } };
41:       }
42:     }
43:     return { status: 404, body: { error: { code: "ROUTE_NOT_FOUND", message: `${method} ${path}` } } };
44:   }
45: }

2: import type { Coupon, CouponRepository } from "../repositories/couponRepository.ts";

7: 
8:   create(input: Record<string, unknown>): Coupon {
9:     const code = input.code;
10:     if (typeof code !== "string" || !/^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,32}$/.test(code)) {
11:       throw badRequest("INVALID_REQUEST", "code must match [A-Z0-9_-]{3,32}");
12:     }
13:     if (input.type !== "FIXED" && input.type !== "PERCENT") {
14:       throw badRequest("INVALID_REQUEST", "type must be FIXED or PERCENT");
15:     }
16:     const value = input.value;
17:     if (!Number.isInteger(value) || (value as number) < 0 || (input.type === "PERCENT" && (value as number) > 100)) {
18:       throw badRequest("INVALID_REQUEST", "value out of range");
19:     }
20:     if (this.coupons.findByCode(code)) throw conflict("COUPON_EXISTS", `coupon ${code} exists`);
21:     const validFrom = String(input.validFrom ?? "");
22:     const validUntil = String(input.validUntil ?? "");
23:     if (Number.isNaN(Date.parse(validFrom)) || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(validUntil))) {
24:       throw badRequest("INVALID_REQUEST", "validFrom / validUntil must be ISO-8601");
25:     }
26:     return this.coupons.insert({
27:       code,
